title: Jeanne Dielman, 23, Quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles (FCP 2026)

title_lang.en: Jeanne Dielman, 23, Quai du Commerce, 1080 Bruxelles (FCP 2026)

synopsis:
Jeanne, a widow, lives in a one-bedroom flat in Brussels with her son Sylvain. She never really loved her husband, and has no intention of ever remarrying. A few small changes to her routine over a thirty-six hour period culminates with something she's never experienced with one of her clients, which threatens what she knows her life to be. She has to decide how that incident will affect her psyche.

 

The film will be introduced by the "Directors' Fortnight's Artistic Director Julien Rejl  on 28 NOVEMBER at PREMIERE ELEMENTS.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
Jeanne是一名寡婦，與兒子Sylvain住在布魯塞爾的一房公寓。她從未真正愛過丈夫，也無意再婚。在短短三十六小時內，她日常生活中幾個微小的改變，導致她與其中一位客戶經歷了一件她從未體驗過的事，這件事威脅到她向來認知的生活。她必須決定這件事會在自己心裡留下怎樣的痕跡。

 

11月28日PREMIERE ELEMENTS 場次將由「導演雙週」藝術總監Julien Rejl  作開場介紹。
